messages:
maya: heads up — we need a small UX + API change: customers want a direct "who changed this" link from routing policy rows to the audit artifact (and ability to include the routing snapshot in exports). Can we scope?

 tj: +1. is the ask just a console deep-link to existing export, or do we need a new export flag to include routing snapshots? :thinking_face:

 maya: both. deep-link first (fast win). long term: add provenance bundle to NDJSON export so legal/infra teams get the exact routing policy at time-of-change. also include quota state (was the tenant over quota when the change happened).

 anna: watch PII. routing policies can contain tenant names and potential IPs in comments. Exports need redaction modes. we already have redaction flags for actor emails — reuse those.

 ryan: implementation note: I don't want to duplicate actor storage. Proposal: export includes a "provenance" object per change event with: actor_id, actor_hint, timestamp, routing_snapshot_id, quota_snapshot_id. For public API, "actor_hint" is a short human string (to preserve readable name without leaking email).

 sam: FYI consumers prefer NDJSON line-per-event (easier to stream). Bundles = NDJSON + accompanying JSON manifest + presigned links for snapshots. Example manifest fields: 
```
manifest_version: 1
scope: tenant|global
items: [{event_id, routing_snapshot_id, snapshot_presigned_url}]
```

 tj: small API debate: `actor_hint` vs `actor_display` vs reusing `actor_id` and resolving client-side. resolving client-side breaks legal/customer handoff for exported bundles (they may not have access to our identity service). So prefer storing de-identified display in export.

 auditor-bot: export triggered: export_1767012345 created by maya (presigned manifest ready in 10m). :sparkles:

 anna: sampling question — do we include all routing-change events or sample? For large tenants there could be thousands/day. Maybe default to full for compliance-tier customers and sampled for others.

 ryan: agree. add `provenance_granularity` param: full|hourly-rollup|sampled-1pct. Default = sampled for free tier, full for enterprise.

 lisa: console UX: we should show a tiny provenance pill on each route row: "changed 3h ago by maya" clickable -> open side panel with exact diff + "download snapshot" CTA. For canary rollouts, show the rollout id and link to rollout trace.

 maya: design + product will sketch the side panel. devs: can we surface a route-level telemetry badge with last-known quota state? green/yellow/red and tooltip with last 24h rejection rate.

 sam: can do. backend needs a compact quota_snapshot (timestamp, tokens_used, throttle_count, last_rejection_reason). Keep shape small for UI perf.

 tj: internal API change: add endpoints: POST /exports?include_provenance=true&granularity=full and GET /routing-snapshots/:id (authed presigned). Also we should version the export schema v2 to not break consumers.

 ryan: versioning + changelog required. add a migration note in exports API docs and a feature flag for rollout.

 anna: compliance ask: exports must include tamper-evidence checksum for snapshots. We should sign the manifest (HMAC) and store verification metadata.

 maya: good call. auditor-bot — include checksum header in manifest generation.

 auditor-bot: checksum header added: X-Export-Signature.

 maya: action items:
- tj: add export API param + v2 schema PR (owner)
- sam: implement compact quota_snapshot endpoint + snapshot storage
- lisa: prototype side-panel UI + pill copy
- ryan: add manifest signing + presigned snapshot endpoint
- anna: write redaction & sampling policy for exports

 tj: I'll open the PRs today and flag for review. tagging @eng-oncall in case of infra churn.

 ryan: timeline?

 maya: aim for canary in 2 sprints, full rollout after compliance review.

 lisa: copy for pill: "last change: 3h — maya — download audit" (fine tune in UX).

 maya: cool, thanks all. I'll follow up with design mocks and legal checklist in the thread. :thumbsup:
